### math/vec3.js
Minimal vec3 utilities. All functions return new arrays, no mutation.

Exports: create, add, subtract, scale, dot, cross, length, normalize

Type: Vec3 = [number, number, number]

### math/mat4.js
Minimal mat4 utilities. Column-major Float32Array(16). Imports vec3 internally.

Exports: create, identity, perspective, perspectiveGL, lookAt, multiply, translate, rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ, scale, reflectY, reflectZ, transpose, normalMatrix, normalMatrix3, invert

Type: Mat4 = Float32Array

Signatures of note:
- perspective(fovY, aspect, near, far) -> Mat4 -- WebGPU clip-Z [0,1].
- perspectiveGL(fovY, aspect, near, far) -> Mat4 -- OpenGL/WebGL clip-Z [-1,1] (use for a WebGL2 pipeline. Contrast perspective above).
- rotateZ(m, angle) -> Mat4 -- rotate about Z (mirrors rotateX/rotateY).
- transpose(m) -> Mat4 -- 4x4 transpose.
- normalMatrix(m) -> Mat4 -- transpose-of-inverse of the upper 3x3, embedded in a 4x4 (returns identity() if singular).
- normalMatrix3(m) -> Float32Array(9) -- the same transform as a column-major mat3 (the GLSL/WGSL normal-matrix form). Returns the identity 3x3 if singular (matching normalMatrix).

### math/sdf.js
Pure signed-distance-field math (no DOM/GPU): primitives, a column-major point transform, a CPU grid bake of an arbitrary scene SDF. Also trilinear sampling with a continuous outside-the-box extension, ray/AABB intersection, and the Inigo Quilez closest-approach soft-shadow march. Mirror these formulas in any WGSL/GLSL twin.

Constants: SDF_SPHERE, SDF_BOX, SDF_CYLINDER, SDF_TORUS

Types:

```ts
SdfParams = readonly [number,number,number,number];
SdfGrid = { data: Float32Array; dims: [number,number,number]; volMin: Vec3; volMax: Vec3 };
SceneSDF = (x,y,z) => number;
SdfAabb = { min: Vec3; max: Vec3 };
SoftShadowOptions, SoftShadowResult = { vis: number; steps: number };
```

Exports:
- sdSphere(p, [radius]), sdBox(p, [hx,hy,hz]), sdCylinder(p, [radius,halfH]), sdTorus(p, [majorR,minorR]) -> number -- local-space primitive distances (Vec3 p).
- primitiveSDF(type, p, params) -> number -- dispatch a primitive by SDF_* id.
- transformPoint(m, p) -> Vec3 -- column-major affine point transform (w=1).
- makeGrid(scene, volMin, volMax, dims) -> SdfGrid -- one-time CPU bake of a scene callback `scene(x,y,z) => distance` into a dense voxel-centre grid.
- trilinear(grid, q) -> number -- trilinear fetch at a clamped [0,1] coordinate.
- sampleGrid(grid, p) -> number -- sample at a world point. Inside = trilinear, outside = max(edgeValue, distanceToBox) (continuous, never falsely shadowed).
- intersectAABB(ro, rd, bmin, bmax) -> [tNear, tFar] (ray misses when tFar < max(tNear,0)).
- softShadow(sampleFn, ro, rd, opts?) -> { vis, steps } -- IQ soft visibility in [0,1]. Opts: { tmin, tmax, k, maxSteps, minStep, maxStep, eps, aabb }.

### math/noise.js
Deterministic procedural noise -- integer hash -> value noise -> fbm, 2D and 3D. Pure. Outputs in [0,1] unless noted. The 2D lattice is tileable (the hash wraps by `cells`). The 3D lattice is unbounded.

Exports:
- hash2(ix, iy, period, seed) -> [0,1) -- tileable 2D lattice hash.
- smootherstep(t) -> number -- quintic easing 6t^5-15t^4+10t^3.
- valueNoise2(u, v, cells, seed) -> [0,1) -- tileable 2D value noise.
- fbm2(u, v, baseCells, octaves, seed) -> [0,1) -- 2D fractal Brownian motion.
- ridged2(u, v, baseCells, octaves, seed) -> [0,1) -- (1-|2*fbm-1|)^2 ridges.
- hash3(x, y, z, seed) -> [0,1) -- 3D lattice hash (non-tiling).
- valueNoise3(x, y, z, seed) -> [0,1) -- 3D value noise.
- fbm3(x, y, z, seed, octaves=4) -> [0,1) -- 3D fractal Brownian motion.

### math/sampling.js
Low-discrepancy + hemisphere sampling. Pure, deterministic. radicalInverse2 / hammersley match the GPU convention in webgpu/shaders/prefilter.wgsl, so the same index yields the same point on CPU and GPU.

Exports:
- radicalInverse2(i) -> [0,1) -- van der Corput base 2 (radicalInverse2(0)=0).
- hammersley(i, n) -> [number, number] -- [i/n, radicalInverse2(i)] (hammersley(0,n)=[0,0]).
- uniformHemisphere(u, v) -> Vec3 -- uniform-solid-angle direction on +Z (u=costheta).
- cosineHemisphere(u, v) -> Vec3 -- cosine-weighted direction on +Z (Malley, r=sqrt(u)).

### math/gaussian-kernel.js
Separable Gaussian blur kernel builder (linear-sampling). Pure math. Merges adjacent tap pairs into one bilinear fetch at a fractional texel offset (halves the texture samples while reproducing the exact discrete Gaussian).

Type: GaussianKernel = { sigma, radius, weights: number[], entries: [offset,weight][] }

Exports:
- MAX_RADIUS: number -- kernel-radius cap (192).
- buildGaussianKernel(sigma) -> GaussianKernel -- entries[0] is the centre tap. Entries[1..] are side taps sampled at BOTH +offset and -offset. Two-sided integer-tap weights sum to exactly 1.
